<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="20" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#1F2125">9:41</text>
    <line x1="325" y1="14" x2="325" y2="20" stroke="#1F2125" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="330" y1="12" x2="330" y2="20" stroke="#1F2125" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="335" y1="10" x2="335" y2="20" stroke="#1F2125" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="348" cy="16" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#1F2125" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="345" y1="13" x2="351" y2="19" stroke="#1F2125" stroke-width="1"/>
    <rect x="360" y="10" width="20" height="11" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#1F2125" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="362" y="12" width="15" height="7" rx="1.5" fill="#009A67"/>
    <rect x="381" y="13" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#1F2125"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Top toolbar -->
  <g>
    <line x1="20" y1="91" x2="370" y2="91" stroke="#F3F5F6" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="20" y="66" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="600" fill="#1F2125">Library</text>

    <!-- Filter outlined action -->
    <g>
      <rect x="205" y="42" width="76" height="36" rx="16" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#B2B5BB" stroke-width="1"/>
      <line x1="221" y1="54" x2="231" y2="54" stroke="#585C62" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <line x1="221" y1="60" x2="229" y2="60" stroke="#585C62" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <line x1="221" y1="66" x2="234" y2="66" stroke="#585C62" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <text x="241" y="65" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#45484C">Filter</text>
    </g>

    <!-- Add primary action -->
    <g>
      <rect x="289" y="42" width="81" height="36" rx="16" fill="#009A67"/>
      <line x1="306" y1="60" x2="316" y2="60" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <line x1="311" y1="55" x2="311" y2="65" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <text x="324" y="65" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Add item</text>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Empty content area -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="195" cy="350" r="76" fill="#F0FBF8"/>
    <rect x="159" y="306" width="72" height="88" rx="12" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#B8EDDC" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="174" y1="326" x2="216" y2="326" stroke="#66D9B3" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="174" y1="341" x2="207" y2="341" stroke="#B8EDDC" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="174" y1="356" x2="213" y2="356" stroke="#B8EDDC" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="174" y1="371" x2="198" y2="371" stroke="#B8EDDC" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <circle cx="220" cy="382" r="17" fill="#009A67"/>
    <line x1="212" y1="382" x2="228" y2="382" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="220" y1="374" x2="220" y2="390" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>

    <text x="195" y="462" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="600" fill="#1F2125">Nothing here yet</text>
    <text x="195" y="489" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#777777">Start building your library by adding</text>
    <text x="195" y="510" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#777777">your first item.</text>

    <g>
      <rect x="132" y="536" width="126" height="48" rx="16" fill="#009A67"/>
      <line x1="157" y1="560" x2="169" y2="560" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="163" y1="554" x2="163" y2="566" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="180" y="565" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Add first item</text>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="760" width="390" height="60" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="20" y1="760" x2="370" y2="760" stroke="#F3F5F6" stroke-width="1"/>

    <!-- Home -->
    <g>
      <polygon points="38,780 48,772 58,780" fill="none" stroke="#009A67" stroke-width="2"/>
      <rect x="41" y="779" width="14" height="12" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#009A67" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="48" y="811" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#009A67">Home</text>
    </g>

    <!-- Discover -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="146" cy="781" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#878B90" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="153" y1="788" x2="160" y2="795" stroke="#878B90" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="146" y="811" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#777777">Discover</text>
    </g>

    <!-- Activity -->
    <g>
      <rect x="230" y="773" width="18" height="18" rx="4" fill="none" stroke="#878B90" stroke-width="2"/>
      <polyline points="234,782 238,786 245,777" fill="none" stroke="#878B90" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="239" y="811" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#777777">Activity</text>
    </g>

    <!-- Profile -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="337" cy="778" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#878B90" stroke-width="2"/>
      <ellipse cx="337" cy="790" rx="10" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#878B90" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="337" y="811" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#777777">Profile</text>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Home indicator -->
  <rect x="145" y="832" width="100" height="4" rx="2" fill="#1F2125"/>
</svg>
